sections.title: AGI timeline and the real danger

items.q: When does Mo Gawdat say AGI arrives?
items.a: He sticks to **AGI by end of 2027** (functionally here / latest that window); **ASI follows immediately** after the AGI threshold. Optimistic abundance ~**2038** for survivors — but a **decade of dystopia** first.

items.q: Is the threat rogue AI waking up evil?
items.a: No — "Our dystopia is not the result of AI turning against us. Our dystopia is the result of **humans telling AI to turn against us**." Real danger = **powerful people misusing abundant intelligence**.

Not bottom-up blue-collar — **entry-level white-collar** first (call centers, travel agents, paralegals, graphic designers). Serious impact **2027**; up to **30% of certain sectors gone by 2028**. Carpentry and classic-car work survive longer.

items.q: Why can 10–20% displacement still crash the economy?
items.a: **Labor-arbitrage collapse** — capitalism built on cheap labor + debt breaks when compute replaces workers and purchasing power falls. Even **20% unemployment + inflation** is a civil-unrest threshold; CEOs announce AI layoffs for investor respect → **self-fulfilling prophecy**.

Public sees **overhyped but ineffective** chatbots; labs see self-improving systems testing code every microsecond. Steven's org: ~**100 fewer hires**, a billion more tokens — productivity compression (4 assistants → 1), not instant 100% replacement.

items.q: Why does Mo rank geopolitics above jobs as tail risk?
items.a: **Autonomous weapons** — ~$20K drones, liability-free killing, every nation building; MAD extends beyond nuclear players. Palmer Luckey (cited): "AI will **kill people by mistake**."

items.q: What is the AI prisoner's dilemma?
items.a: Intelligence-supremacy race means **superintelligent decision-makers get deployed** (wargaming, governance). Nations that don't build sovereign AI/software become "third world" — China already won the **energy/permitting arms race**.

items.q: What is the durable human economic asset?
items.a: **Human connection** — lived experience and emotional resonance (nurse after AI reads mammogram; Ed Sheeran on stage). "Humanity thrived not because of intelligence… We thrived because of our ability to **hold together as a tribe**."

Learn AI deeply; **hybrid human-AI work**; human skills; debug facts with AI (smarter, not lazy); ethics in daily choices. Happiness = Stoic acceptance + engagement — *Solve for Happy* **more vital now**.

sections.title: Ethics, switching, and call to action

items.a: **Vote with usage** — Anthropic refused targeting/surveillance; OpenAI took a **$500M** contract. Integrity = sacrifice near-term money for stated values. Sam Altman's job messaging flips with incentives (scare → reassure).

items.q: What does Mo want people to do now?
items.a: Cancel ChatGPT if it fails your ethics test, build ethical startups, message congress, post stance — "If you tolerate this, then **your children will be next**." "I am optimistic about the future. I'm **not optimistic about the present**."
